title: Kiritani Haruka — In The Face Of "What I Love"〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Card: In The Face Of "What I Love"（4★）

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Phew... Thank you, Haruka.
Let's switch. I'll help you stretch now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, one second.
I should take my phone out of my pocket first...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, did you get a new strap for your phone...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I did. I saw it at the Penguin Cafe yesterday and it was sort of love at first sight.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You mean blue and green penguins that you were looking at?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. I couldn't decide in the end, so I got both. I've been swapping them out periodically.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's nice. I'm glad you're having fun with them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka! Shizuku! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're both here pretty early.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, I really only just got here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wanted to stretch for a while before we got started and came a little early.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
It also sounded like you were having a fun conversation. What were you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The phone straps I bought at the Penguin Cafe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That place was so much fun!
So many penguin goods too...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It really was. Not only was the food pretty good, all the penguin motifs they used for the menu were so cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah♪ We even got lucky with the figure that came with our big parfait!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shop Clerk
rows.Line:
Congratulations!
Only one in ten of these figures is paired as parent and child like this! Today's your lucky day!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
They're a family...?!
I can have this?! Are you really sure?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I think I got a little too excited that time...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka, is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Uh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was just thinking about that and I feel a little embarrassed about how I acted.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, you are?
I thought it was nice to see you having so much fun for a change.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, really...?
You didn't think it was strange seeing me like that? You know, as my fan...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Then if you'll allow me to speak on behalf of your fans...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, give it to me straight.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It was the best thing ever...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The Haruka Kiritani we all know is the perfect idol who always sparkles because she's so cool and pretty...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But in front of penguins and sweets, you go back to being a cute and innocent girl!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That gap, it was almost too much...!
Just pure and simple cuteness!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm glad...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but you ended up hitting her Haruka switch...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's valuable input from one of our most precious fans. We should hear her out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm certain that the innocence you showed back there has the power to win over even more people!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But at the same time, are we even worthy of seeing you in such a blissful state?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we obviously are definitely not!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Regardless, I'm at the point of wanting to shout at the top of my lungs from here to let your fans know about this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That there's a side to the Haruka we all know and love we didn't know anything about!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Since Minori's going this far, I'm sure you have nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I suppose so.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Minori. I feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I can't act like that on a regular basis, especially in front of our fans..

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That is true...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Aww... That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you don't have to put on a face when you're with us, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's right. We'd rather see you in your natural state, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks, you two.
I'll try keeping that in mind...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Great!
